title: Note: sub-cards in the next column — tomorrow's first build

text: Heard and written up as the first brief for tomorrow: the rail stays resizable, the detail page takes the rest with a measure, and a sub-card (a task, a proposal, a transcript paragraph) opens in a third column to its right with the address as the path — dig down, come back up; the detail page carries a table of contents of its sub-cards; the footer shrinks to one line with a proper edge; the two scrollbars become one. It starts on the per-card storage decided at 19:42, with a migration that counts every event in and out.
